name: Game of Life
summary: Conway's Game of Life: launch it from the apps menu, or play a life code block inline.
description: Adds a Play permission and a life command. A member who holds the permission can launch a live board from the composer's apps menu, or seed one from a life code block - a preset (glider, gun, pulsar, ...), an ASCII drawing, or a random soup - then play, step, draw and clear it. Each generation is one sandboxed run, so the world is a pure function of its own state.
author: slim-m

permissions.name: Play cellular automata
permissions.description: Seed, play and step a Game of Life board in this space.
